font_families.font_family_cn: Android platform SansSerif; Compose FontFamily.SansSerif with OS CJK script/locale fallback
font_families.font_family_digits: Android platform SansSerif; no tabular-digit face is declared
font_families.license: No app-bundled font file or project-level font license artifact is present. Face and vendor license are supplied by the Android platform and are not pinned by this repository.
font_families.fallback: Android OS locale/script-aware font fallback. The exact CJK face is device/vendor resolved and is not pinned.
font_families.portability: Android-specific mapping; other renderers require an explicit platform mapping and cannot infer a font from a screenshot.

tokens.usage: Hero and editorial title; default shared role.

tokens.usage: Page title unless a registered navigation/page exception applies.

tokens.name: Button
tokens.usage: Generic button label; component contract takes precedence.

tokens.name: Numeric
tokens.usage: General numeric value for length, weight, dates and statistics; page data formatting remains page-owned.

tokens.name: Label
tokens.usage: Alias of Caption; a naming alias only and introduces no additional scale.

allowed: Brand Hero may refer only to an approved brand font source or existing frozen brand artwork; no new family is inferred.
Fish Species Name may use its registered page size/line-height while retaining the shared family and weight catalog.
Large Statistic may use the registered Normal Home Font A reference-pixel mapping, which converts to sp and continues to honor OS fontScale.
forbidden: Page-private font family or unregistered fallback.
Page-defined private size scale outside a referenced page authority.
Silent text shrink, canceled fontScale, unregistered letter spacing, or color literals.
override_policy.shared_family_change_requires: Explicit owner decision D-007; do not replace a frozen page visual.

page_overrides.rule: Only an approved brand font source or already frozen brand artwork can carry the calligraphic role. No font file/license is identified in the source; current Android mapping is SansSerif.
Page authority may set size and line-height for species hierarchy; family and weight remain in shared catalog; preserve page authority.
Use Normal Home Font A reference-pixel contract and its explicit width/density conversion to sp. Keep the source values page-scoped; OS fontScale remains enabled.
Use the registered centered-title exception and state-specific result contract; do not promote its geometry to a global navigation variant.

page_audit.finding: Core Visual names BRAND/DISPLAY/UI but no font face; runtime maps SansSerif. Keep as a source conflict; do not infer from Frozen PNG.
Approved Font A uses reference-pixel sizes and the registered conversion formula; do not translate raw px directly to sp.
Centered title and state-specific result typography remain page authorities.
Shared family with page-scoped media text / ON_MEDIA color roles; A/B Frozen visuals remain authoritative.
Species title sizing is page-owned; large text grows its container and keeps semantic order.

tracking_rule: 0sp unless a page/component authority registers a specific override.
font_scale_rule: Honor Android OS fontScale; expand containers and scroll when needed; never silently shrink or cancel scaling.
unresolved: C-007 / D-007: calligraphic brand intent conflicts with the current SansSerif runtime map; no named CJK face/license is pinned; owner approval is still required.
